text:
Type: white woven storage basket
Use: storing blankets, magazines, papers or small items on a shelf or the floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: Scandinavian, farmhouse, coastal
Materials: wide flat woven strips in a matte white finish, riveted rim band
Colors: white, off-white
Shape: rectangular open basket with slightly flared sides, a chunky checkerboard weave with small gaps, flat reinforced rim, medium sized, light and open
Feel: fresh, tidy, airy, casual
Goes with: white or light wood shelves, linen, pastel tones; Scandinavian, coastal or farmhouse rooms

product.name: KNARRA
product.description: Collecting newspapers, toys, hats and gloves in baskets makes it easier to find what you need and keeps the room looking neat and uncluttered.
